issues.issue: This is debt-service spending (the Statement of Activities p2 shows interest expense 16,156.25, which leaves 35,000 principal), but the report prints it under other financing uses, so it is recorded as other_financing rather than as a disbursement. That follows the as-printed rule, but it leaves governmental debt service out of disbursements, and decision_needed has no entry asking whether it should count as spending.
